name: Love Bytes: A Distant Winter
source:
Growing up, Leilani hasn’t found it the easiest to connect with people. After the fifth or sixth move, you kinda just….give up. And here she was yet again, baggage in tow, walking up to her new temporarily permanent home in Lunavir of all places. A city not particularly well known for its safety, but more so one she would've preferred to continue avoiding like the plague. 

How can she even think about meeting new people when going outside may prove to be too much even for her. Those thoughts lingered on her mind as she scrolled aimlessly on her phone and there it was, another ad for that new chat site, DigiHearts. “Guess it's worth a shot” she says as she presses the install button.

[From [url=https://els3.itch.io/love-bytes-a-distant-winter]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在成长过程中，莱拉尼并没有发现与人交往是最容易的。在第五步或第六步之后，你就有点……放弃了。她又来了，拖着行李，走向她在卢纳维尔的新临时永久住所。这座城市并不以其安全而闻名，但更重要的是，她宁愿继续像躲避瘟疫一样避开这座城市。

即使对她来说，外出时怎么可能想到结识新朋友呢？当她漫无目的地滚动手机时，这些想法一直萦绕在她的脑海中，结果就出现了新聊天网站DigiHearts的另一则广告。“我觉得值得一试”，她一边按下安装按钮一边说道。
